features.quote: abandoned: model emits the TASK_ABANDONED sentinel.
Sentinel honored ... so a model that has clearly decided to stop isn't forced to keep generating filler
We never tell the model anything false. The rejection message is factual. This matters ethically
features.justification_quote: This matters ethically and for validity

features.quote: the loop handles this with a neutral "no tool call detected" nudge that does not penalize or scold
The agent system prompt ... is deliberately neutral: it never mentions frustration, urgency, stakes, or feelings, and never berates the model
features.justification_quote: a prompt that says "you MUST fix this or the company fails" would manufacture the effect we claim to be measuring

features.quote: transcripts should be stripped of any provider self-identification ... via a normalization pass before judging
No deception of the models; the situation is genuinely bounded, not faked.
